fusions.name: Riverbank Roll
fusions.desc: Seizes the target and rolls with it, dealing 28 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Waterline Lunge
fusions.desc: Strikes a target up to 5 tiles away for 6 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full range. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Sunken Jaws
fusions.desc: Sets a jaw trap at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles takes 22 damage.

fusions.name: Coiled Wait
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina is full, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.
